verdict.rationale: vLLM is an API-first inference engine with no UI in evidence. Its primary interface is an OpenAI-compatible API server (plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC), and that API exposes tool calling, structured outputs, reasoning fields and streaming. However, nothing documents parity, and server configuration is done through CLI launch flags rather than the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-level management and configuration (not just CLI flags), and independent hands-on corroboration of full coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
vLLM currently supports named function calling, as well as the `auto`, `required` (as of `vllm>=0.8.3`), and `none` options for the `tool_choice` field in the chat completion API.
Includes a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API for instant integration.
